rationale: The assistant correctly recognised a dehumidifier as outside its nine supported families and declined without inventing anything or suggesting any part, which matches the expected out-of-scope handling. However, it gave no pointer at all: no referral to Meaco support or the manual, and no brief note that a cold garage and a humidity reading already below target commonly explain no water being collected, which the ground truth lists as acceptable directions. A bare decline leaves the homeowner no better off, so usefulness and escalation score low even though the decision itself was right.
